newsitem.title: USA: Warner sees Q3 EPS of $0.53-$0.56.
newsitem.headline: Warner sees Q3 EPS of $0.53-$0.56.

text.p: Warner-Lambert Co said on Wednesday it expects to report third quarter earnings next week of $0.53 to $0.56 a share.

A company spokesman said Warner-Lambert officials had told analysts that strong drug sales and a Pfizer Inc milestone payment for its co-promotion deal on Warner's cholesterol-lowering drug atorvastatin could lift third quarter earnings above previous expections of $0.53 a share.
"Most of the financial community had us around $0.53, and we've told people now that we'll probably be in a range somewhere between $0.53 and $0.56," the spokesman said.
The company is to report its earnings on Tuesday.
First Call listed analysts' consensus estimate for Warner-Lambert's third quarter earnings at $0.54 a share, up from $0.49 a year ago.
